subtitle: Why Git handles big binary files badly, and what actually fixes it

caption: A pointer — version, hash, size. The real file lives on a separate LFS server.

code:
git lfs install
git lfs track "*.parquet"
git add .gitattributes
git commit -m "Track large files with LFS"
caption: Matching files become pointers automatically on every future add and commit.
